historical239.historicalNormalizedText: It is deliberately broader than a single coding prompt. It should be treated as:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: - the context document that a new work-mode chat should inspect before producing the prompt for the first implementation.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The next work-mode chat should not immediately attempt to train a Meshy-scale foundation model or modify every Closy and ZeroOne subsystem. It should first inspect the relevant repositories, compare them with the contracts and phases in this document, and then produce a tightly bounded implementation prompt for the first milestone described in Section 22.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: That decision is the main protection against building an impressive image-to-3D demo that cannot later fit, animate, resize, layer or simulate clothing correctly.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Closy should be developed as two cooperating but independently testable halves.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Do not wait for ZeroOne to be fully complete before starting Half One. Most of the difficult Closy work occurs before virtualised geometry is relevant. At the same time, do not recreate ZeroOne's generic geometry pipeline inside Closy.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The two halves should meet at a versioned package and command-line/API boundary:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: ZeroOne must remain optional during early development. Every garment package must retain a conventional GLB or equivalent fallback so that Closy can continue functioning when ZeroOne processing is unavailable or incomplete.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: This is not merely “turn an image into a mesh.” A successful garment must support:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 1. Identity — it should still look like the uploaded garment.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 2. Structure — sleeves, collar, waist, panels, openings and seams should be represented meaningfully.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 3. Fit — it should align to a body of known shape and measurements.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 4. Simulation — it should drape and move rather than behave like a rigid statue.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 5. Editability — dimensions, fit, material and appearance should be adjustable.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 6. Layering — it should eventually coexist with underwear, shirts, jackets and accessories.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 7. Animation — it should follow a posed or animated avatar.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 8. Scalability — it should have desktop, mobile and high-detail render derivatives.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 9. Traceability — the system should know which regions are observed, inferred or generated.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: 10. Safety and privacy — user photographs and body estimates must be handled as sensitive personal data.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A generic image-to-3D model tries to produce a visually plausible surface. Garment reconstruction must infer hidden panels, openings, seams, body clearance and physical behaviour.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A clean triangle or quad mesh can still be structurally wrong. Closy needs to know that an edge is a cuff, an armhole, a waistband or one side of a stitched seam.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Clustered virtual geometry determines what detail should be rendered and streamed. It does not decide how fabric stretches, bends, collides or settles.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Millions of triangles can encode noise, self-intersections and hallucinated details. Quality must be measured by structure, fidelity, deformation and runtime behaviour, not triangle count alone.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: These principles should survive individual model and library changes.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The canonical garment should contain an explicit pattern and seam graph whenever the category supports cut-and-sew construction.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Closy should not force one mesh to perform every job. A garment may have:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Cloth physics should run on a regular, semantically useful simulation mesh. The dense mesh follows it through a stored binding.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Meshy, Hunyuan3D, TRELLIS and future models should sit behind adapters. Replacing a provider must not rewrite the garment package, simulation or app.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Every reconstructed region should be marked as observed, triangulated from several views, inferred from symmetry, generated by a prior or manually corrected.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Ambiguous images cannot always determine hidden construction. The system should provide concise correction tools instead of silently inventing certainty.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Every pipeline stage should record its input hashes, model versions, parameters, random seed, output hashes, warnings and timings.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A valid Closy garment must exist before ZeroOne processing. ZeroOne may add premium derivatives but must not silently change canonical seams or simulation topology.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Logos, text, patterns, trim and silhouette visible in source photographs should be preserved by projection or reconstruction. Generative inpainting should mainly fill genuinely unseen regions.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The initial vertical slice should be a basic short-sleeved T-shirt on one fixed avatar. Arbitrary garments should emerge from proven category families, not from a premature universal model.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The first half should be deployable as a headless service and CLI. The mobile app should submit capture data, receive job progress and display resulting assets; it should not run large 3D foundation models locally in the first versions.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The pipeline should support several input modes, but they should be introduced in increasing order of difficulty.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: - scale still requires a reference or measurements.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The pipeline must separate:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The app should guide distance, framing, turn angle and lighting. It should reject or warn about severe blur, clipped regions, mirrors, hands covering seams or inconsistent garments across views.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A slow turn or orbit can provide many views and temporal mask consistency. Frames should be selected for sharpness and viewpoint coverage rather than processing the entire video indiscriminately.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Single-image reconstruction should remain available, but output confidence must be lower. Hidden surfaces, rear construction and fabric behaviour are underdetermined.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The system should work without all metadata but should use it to reduce uncertainty.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Each capture set should receive a machine-readable score covering:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Low-quality captures should be rejected before expensive model inference where possible.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A job record should include:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: - original files are never overwritten;
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: - external-provider use is recorded and requires the applicable consent;
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The pipeline should preserve both a visually normalised image and an evidence image. Aggressive cleanup should not destroy logos, stitching, fabric grain or shadows needed for geometry inference.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The visual-understanding subsystem should be provider-based. It may use a promptable segmentation foundation model, a fashion-specific segmentation network, or both.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Required masks and labels include:
historical239.reason: split, reclassified, repeated or changed source; inspect anchors

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: For video or multi-view input, identities should be tracked across frames. A sleeve in one frame should retain the same semantic identity in another.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The output must be editable. A small amount of user correction to a mask can be more valuable than a long downstream optimisation against the wrong silhouette.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A parametric body model such as SMPL-family technology may be useful for research, but Closy must hide it behind an IBodyModel abstraction. Commercial rights, generated-output rights and model/software licences must be reviewed independently. The system must not bake a restrictive research-only dependency into its core data contract.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Initial development should use one fixed, clean Closy avatar with:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Personalised body recovery should be added after the basic garment pipeline works.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: For multiple images, the pipeline should determine which observations refer to the same surface regions.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Multi-view diffusion may generate missing views, but generated views must be labelled as synthetic evidence. They should support hidden-surface hypothesis generation, not overrule real photographs.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A garment should be described before it is meshed.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The ontology should gradually cover:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The semantic graph should contain nodes such as:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Each semantic entity should have a stable ID that survives remeshing. Raw vertex indices are not stable semantic identifiers.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: The graph should also encode:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Closy should define its own versioned pattern schema, informed by systems such as GarmentCode and recent structured garment representations, but not permanently tied to one research project's implementation.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A panel should contain:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Boundary curves should support at least:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A seam should contain:
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: Pattern inference should evolve through four levels.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited

historical239.historicalNormalizedText: A multimodal model generates a constrained pattern program or structured graph. The result must pass grammar, geometry and simulation validators before use.
historical239.reason: location and roadmap mapping recomputed; historical status not inherited
